name: silvergale-monstrosity-call-prepare-2-paid-moves-sheen-to-obelith
notes: Silvergale Monstrosity's Call (lsLd8ADGAe, EXALTED/WIND ASSASSIN ACTION, reserve 3): "Prepare 2. Summon a Memorite Obelith token. If Silvergale Monstrosity's Call was prepared, move any amount of sheen counters from your Fractured Memories onto any amount of allies named Memorite Obelith you control." Player 2's champion is Tristan, Shadowdancer (ASSASSIN, UMBRA) patched in with extra lineage cards to unlock the card's element; ATTACK cards cannot be played by the first player on turn 1, so player 1 ends turn 1 and player 2 plays the card with real actions (10002 FSM play, 100 reserve payments / YES-NO answer / attack target). Player 2's mastery holds a Fractured Memories with 5 sheen counters. (The spell is not Fast, so no 'Take a fast action?' confirmation.) 'Any amount' is resolved as the pre-existing generated behaviour did: all the sheen onto the first Memorite Obelith. Player 2 pays Prepare 2: a Memorite Obelith is summoned and all 5 sheen move from the Fractured Memories onto it.

rulesClauses: If Silvergale Monstrosity's Call was prepared, move any amount of sheen counters from your Fractured Memories onto any amount of allies named Memorite Obelith you control.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The CardEditor ability row for this card never queued the fixed Prepare cost: no $cardActivatedAbilities['lsLd8ADGAe:0'] entry existed (or, for the Strike from the Mist stub, it was an empty '(engine)' body), so OnCardActivated() queued no 'Pay Prepare N?' decision and wasPrepared was never YES. Live state dump on HEAD 47028d36 before the fix: after the last reserve payment the decision queue went straight to the attack-target / ally-target choice (no YESNO), preparation counters stayed untouched, and answering YES was rejected as 'Invalid selection' (or silently ignored) -- so the card's 'if prepared' rider was unreachable. The generated body also summoned and read wasPrepared synchronously. Fix: hand-authored $cardActivatedAbilities['lsLd8ADGAe:0'] queues the Prepare 2 YES/NO then customDQHandlers['GASilvergaleResolve'] (summon; when prepared move the sheen onto the first Memorite Obelith matched by NAME rather than by any MEMORITE subtype).
